_doc: Example GitHub branch ruleset that makes the 'guardrails' check required on main. Apply it by hand (repo Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> New ruleset -> Import), or via the REST API if you choose to. This repo never calls the GitHub API for you. The required status-check context name must match the job name in .github/workflows/guardrails.yml (job id 'guardrails'); confirm the exact context shown on a PR's checks list and adjust if your setup reports it differently.
name: guardrails-required-on-main
